capability: Local-first native app with no account or hosted dependency
acceptance: Installed app opens offline and edits saved workspaces without contacting a service; network actions require an explicit operation.

capability: Versioned atomic workspace storage and migrations
acceptance: Migrate each prior Rill schema transactionally; validate identities and references; failed load never overwrites the original; concurrent windows cannot lose updates.

capability: Bounded resource use across every execution path
acceptance: Exercise unknown-length and exact-limit bodies plus cancellation; bound preview/history/run/stream/archive/subprocess/JSON depth budgets and show truncation explicitly.

capability: Background work, lifecycle and error recovery
acceptance: Every long operation stays off the UI thread; closing a view cancels owned tasks and closes channels; errors preserve drafts and allow retry.
Keep existing 10 cases green; add macOS toolchain/architecture coverage, no skipped required integration cases, and fixture logs on failures.
Keep no-bypass PR requirement and force-push/deletion protection; plan a required successful Swift CI check before parity work merges; use feature branches.
No old source/assets/tests/JARs enter Rill; each new dependency gets current upstream compatibility, license, vulnerability and packaged-runtime review before selection.

capability: Collection create, rename, delete and empty collections
acceptance: Persist empty groups; rename without changing identity; deleting a group shows affected count and supports cancel before cascading deletion.
Save, rename, duplicate, delete and move retain all body/auth/test/hook/file settings; duplicates get new identities and correct credential associations.
Drag and keyboard reorder save immediately; filtered lists preserve hidden items; runner follows saved order after restart.
Opening a request reuses its tab; pin/unpin, close, reopen and restore ordered tabs and active selection after restart.
Separate unsaved recovery data from saved requests; close, navigation, deletion and quit show coherent save/discard/cancel behavior; no silent edits to saved items.

capability: Search across requests, collections, environments and history
acceptance: Cmd+K searches all entity types and recent activity; opening a result restores correct context without forced sidebar scrolling.
Create, rename, delete, persist selection and edit enabled values; renaming retains linked requests; switching does not mutate drafts.
Parent/child overrides, multiple levels, missing-parent and cycle detection; deleting parent detaches children without discarding local values.
Resolve nested environment references in URL/query/headers/body/auth, preserve ordinary braces and report unknown variables or cycles without a request being sent.
Provide independently authored REST GET, JSON POST, Bearer GET and GraphQL templates; instantiation creates editable requests with new IDs.
JSON/XML/text/form syntax, independent template highlighting, explicit lossless formatting, large bodies and duplicate JSON keys handled without silent normalization.

capability: Editor search, zoom, wrap, gutter and undo
acceptance: Preserve text, caret, selection and undo through edits/theme switches; consistent code font at every zoom; usable 100 KB JSON and long strings.
Suggest standard and learned headers/parameter names, supported content types and selected-environment references with keyboard acceptance.
Persist sidebar/split sizes; offer side-by-side request/response at wide widths and a readable stacked alternative; keep response useful at compact sizes.
Preserve visible active request through focus/tab/workspace changes; Cmd+N/T/W/K/Enter, Escape and keyboard ordering work; request deletion can be undone or confirmed.
Verify all supported methods, empty bodies, duplicate query keys, existing percent encoding, literal plus/spaces, fragments, blank/disabled fields and override precedence.
Preserve supported repeated headers or reject loss explicitly; validate all header-producing paths; default headers are overridable and preview/export uses the actual frozen prepared request.

capability: Text, JSON, XML and form-encoded body modes
acceptance: Represent none separately from empty text; add structured form fields with correct encoding and content type; explicitly handle GET/HEAD body limitations.

capability: Multipart text, JSON and file parts
acceptance: Enable/disable/reorder parts; preserve filenames, MIME types and file references; stream files; generated boundary always matches wire bytes; expanded edit Apply/Cancel is lossless.
Select and stream a file without loading it all into memory; missing/unreadable/changed files produce actionable errors; preserve reference metadata.
Validate saved timeout range, cancel stalled headers and chunked bodies, close sessions, prevent stale response races and distinguish timeout from user cancellation.

capability: Response download, preview and retention budgets
acceptance: Independently configure bounded download/preview/history sizes; test exact and unknown lengths, compressed payload expansion, budget metadata and no partial body misrepresented as complete.

capability: None, Basic, Bearer and API-key authentication
acceptance: Add API key in header or query without duplicating existing values; verify UTF-8 Basic and header validation; explicit auth/header precedence is documented.
Name, edit, select and delete credential profiles independently of requests; absent secrets never silently fall back to a different profile.

capability: Named native secrets and environment indirection
acceptance: Add named Keychain CRUD and secret references; resolve through environment indirection without copying secrets into saved environment maps; handle locked/denied/deleted Keychain items visibly.
Acquire tokens with scope and error handling; save secrets/tokens securely; apply chosen token to requests and keep it out of logs/reports/exports by default.
Open system browser, validate callback state and verifier, exchange code and cancel/timeout safely; loopback listener only during authorization; test rejection paths.
Resolve normalized named secrets from a documented Rill-specific process-environment prefix for headless/CI use; define provider precedence, reject writes/deletes and never persist fallback values.

capability: TLS defaults and named trust profiles
acceptance: Retain system certificate/hostname verification; support selected custom trust anchors and persisted profiles, with actionable trust failures.
Import/select client identity including PKCS#12 with secure passphrase handling; validate custom trust and hostname behavior against a local TLS server.
If retaining Relay's HTTP verification override, make it per-profile and visibly marked; never silently disable verification across HTTP or broker clients.
Display status, elapsed time, size, MIME and effective URL; copy full wrapped header values; text selection and export preserve original bytes.
Detect JSON/XML/HTML/image/text/binary; safely preview without remote content or active HTML execution; retain raw bytes and explicit unsupported/oversized states.

capability: Response tests, raw payload, timeline and inspector
acceptance: Show effective redacted request after auth/substitution, response checks and execution events as distinct inspectors; explain available timing granularity honestly.
Replace session-only history with opt-in persistent, bounded request/response snapshots and per-exchange inspection; define redaction/deletion/retention and record truncation.
Compare two retained exchanges by JSON value/path without whitespace or key-order noise; handle arrays, scalars, non-JSON and truncated payloads explicitly.
Preview and validate import before applying; remap identities/references transactionally; document secret policy; failed import leaves workspace and destination files intact.
Parse safely without invoking a shell; round-trip method, URL, headers and body/file references; reject unrepresentable flags with warnings.
Accept workspace/space, collection, request and environment shapes; preserve grouping and move marked secrets to Keychain.
Preview/import/export common HTTP/auth/body/file fields, BOM-prefixed JSON and nested folder breadcrumbs; warn on unsupported scripts/tests/OAuth/inheritance.

capability: Insomnia v4 JSON and v5 YAML interoperability
acceptance: Import/export requests/environments and supported form/file/auth fields; state hierarchy-flattening limitations and retain foreign script source disabled where supported.
Handle request fields and explicit auth headers; label request-only exports with unexecuted response placeholders; do not invent captured exchanges.

capability: Bruno files, folders and ZIP bundles
acceptance: Read individual .bru, folders and ZIP; export valid bundle metadata and plain environments; reject unsupported file/form body exports before writing.
List supported and dropped semantics before apply; foreign scripts never auto-enable; unsupported auth/body combinations fail before overwriting destination.
Enforce input/entry/expanded-size/count/depth limits, reject traversal/symlink paths and ZIP bombs, retain file references without uploading local files implicitly.

capability: cURL and HTTPie generation from a frozen request
acceptance: Resolve variables/pre-hook once without sending traffic; support repeated headers and local file references; generated syntax round-trips through the importer.
Generate requests/httpx and fetch/axios with imports and dependency hints; verify escaping, JSON, binary/multipart and target-specific GET/HEAD limits.

capability: Java, Go, Rust and C# client snippets
acceptance: Generate Java HttpClient/OkHttp, Go net/http, Rust reqwest and C# with independently authored templates; compile representative outputs and explain dependencies.

Mask common credential headers by default with explicit opt-in; reject lossy repeated headers for unsupported targets; exact multipart bytes/boundary and bounded embedding; warn that URLs/bodies may contain secrets.
Support status equality, header existence/contains, body contains and JSON-path equality; distinguish missing/invalid/unsupported checks from passes.
Extract JSON paths and headers into run-local variables; later requests see successful extractions; failed steps do not leak changes or modify saved environments.
Use same preparation/execution/check engine as individual sends; honor saved order, iteration counts and progress; support desktop and headless clients.
Explicit delay/retry budgets, no implicit retries, stop-on-failure versus continue and per-attempt outcomes; cancellation interrupts pacing and in-flight requests.

capability: Run reports and bounded retained outcomes
acceptance: Bound executions (baseline 10000) and shared response memory (baseline 32 MiB); preserve metadata/checks after retention exhaustion; empty/cancelled runs cannot pass.
Redact URLs/bodies/runtime secrets/sensitive failures by default; preserve per-request outcomes, duration, counts and cancellation without script logs.

capability: JUnit XML and Allure result files
acceptance: Produce valid per-request test/failure/time/cancelled data and standard Allure result files; verify redaction and unsuccessful empty/cancelled exit behavior.
Run 1–16 selected environments with concurrency 1–4, isolated variables/hooks, status/check comparisons and SHA-256 body fingerprints; indicate dynamic-value differences and not-run steps.
Set request count/concurrency/ramp-up/environment, cancel cleanly and report success/failure, throughput and min/p50/p95/p99/max; validate percentile math and user-selected targets.
Persist enabled flag and hook source through save/duplicate/move/recovery; execute pre-hook before substitution, post-hook after extraction, retries repeat hooks; imports stay disabled.
Provide new documented API for get/set/unset variables, URL/body/header mutation, response status/headers/body, assertions and bounded logs; no dependency on the old SDK implementation.
Choose next step by ID or unique name within collection or stop explicitly; failed assertions take precedence and failed post-hook changes do not propagate; enforce execution budget.

capability: Offline crypto, clock and nonce helpers
acceptance: Implement SHA-256/HMAC-SHA256, Unix milliseconds and UUID helpers; verify deterministic signing text and never transmit data from the script environment.

Choose a maintained engine/isolation design; deny host/files/network/process/environment access; enforce time/memory/statement/input/output/log limits and kill infinite loops; do not claim an OS sandbox without proof.
Implement UUID, Unix seconds, synthetic example.test email and inclusive random integers with validation; each occurrence independent, nested variables supported; reject unknown generators.
Load local JSON/YAML and explicit URLs; handle folded/literal blocks, BOM, anchors/aliases/flow maps with bounded parsing; report unsupported/malformed paths.
Generate grouped requests from tags/operations, server variables, path/query/header parameters, examples/schema samples, local references and Basic/Bearer/API-key/OAuth2/OpenID auth metadata.
Persist source snapshots and generated identity; classify added/changed/removed/config-only drift; show plan before apply and preserve unchanged locally edited requests.

Validate required path/query/header/cookie parameters and request bodies, documented response status/media type and request/response schemas; missing headers and unknown unsupported rules must not pass silently.
Support type/required/properties/enum/const/items/additionalProperties, numeric/string/array bounds, nullable, allOf/anyOf/oneOf and local refs; publish unsupported keywords and external-ref policy.
Detect operation response/shared-schema/example changes independent of formatting and preserve documented samples in mock/test generation.
Create at least one linked positive test per operation with documented success status; identify credentials/path/example gaps before run; do not claim negative-case coverage.
Edit method/path/status/headers/body routes, bind explicitly, start/stop and recover from port conflicts without blocking UI; serve deterministic local fixtures.
Generate routes from documented response examples and bounded schema samples; preview changes and never imply complete schema conformance.
Dedicated endpoint/auth-header/query/JSON-variable editors generate explicit JSON POST; report validation and server GraphQL errors separately from transport failures.
Manual and opt-in endpoint-change introspection, schema details and offline reload; disabled introspection produces usable error without repeated unsolicited requests.
Ctrl+Space completes introspected field/argument prefixes; document that this baseline is not a type-aware language server.

Implement graphql-transport-ws acknowledgement, init payload, ping/pong, query events, cancellation and bounded timelines; explicitly exclude legacy subscriptions-transport-ws unless separately implemented.
Connect with headers, send messages and inspect inbound/outbound/error/close events; handle fragmentation/binary messages and stop on leave/cancel with size/timeline limits.
Stream named events with IDs/data and bounded parsing/timeline; cancel stalled connections and document retry/reconnect policy without silently replaying.
Load local .proto or descriptor sets, imports and well-known types with actionable malformed/missing-import errors; bundle selected compiler per architecture if needed.
List methods and filter by call mode; attempt reflection v1 then v1alpha; work with loaded descriptors when reflection is disabled.

capability: All four native gRPC call modes
acceptance: Unary, client/server/bidirectional streaming with protobuf JSON, editable deadlines and metadata including base64 binary values; individual send and finish-sending controls.
Verified TLS or explicit plaintext; cancel and mode/view changes close active calls/channels; one call per session and bounded messages/timeline; state custom-trust support separately.
CLI can send one message and half-close stream; native transport is default and requires no grpcurl; decide separately whether optional external-tool compatibility is needed.
Independently chosen native transport supports connect/auth/subscribe/publish/disconnect with verified TLS; show rejected subscriptions and connection deadlines.
Support QoS 0/1/2 with broker acknowledgements including QoS2 handshake; wildcard subscription uses a separate concrete publish topic; MQTT5 payload format/content-type properties.
Support appropriate tcp/mqtt/ssl/mqtts/ws/wss endpoints, mqtt subprotocol, preserved path/query and fragmented binary frames; bound in-flight operations; explicit reconnect/redirect policy.
Bootstrap/topic/group controls, consume from latest without committing offsets, publish waits for acknowledgement, timeline reports asynchronous connectivity/errors.
Support SASL/PLAIN and verified TLS; validate native client packaging/compression dependencies on each architecture; no JVM/JAR reuse or implied schema-registry/admin support.
Connect/authenticate to existing queue, consume with acknowledgement and publish through default exchange; verified TLS/hostname checks; no implicit topology creation.
Generate UUID/source/type/time/specversion and parsed JSON data; attach content-type metadata for Kafka/MQTT5/AMQP; reject invalid envelope/data clearly.
Independent scrolling settings/timeline, explicit connect/publish/stop, 1 MiB baseline message cap and bounded headers/inflight work; teardown on disconnect and leave.
Evaluate HSTS, HTML CSP, sniffing and CORS hygiene with actionable evidence and limitations; findings are indicators rather than security certification.
Opt-in GET/HEAD single-query quote/reflection probes and sequential rate sample capped at ten; validate target/method, cancel and disclose extra requests; no-429 is not proof of missing rate limits.
Create consistent archive of saved workspace and optional drafts; explicit secret policy and sensitive-archive notice; handle partially written files and permissions.
Preview replacement and require acknowledgement; reject traversal/bombs; retain prior workspace and stop/reload stale editors before writing restored data.
Checkpoint separately from saved requests (baseline every two seconds); surface unsaved recovery after forced termination and disclose possible checkpoint loss.
Export toolchain/version/storage/operation failure diagnostics without workspace bodies, URLs, credentials or secret-bearing logs; test redaction using seeded secrets.
Explicitly operate on the workspace repository, display status and commit changes; keep runtime secret stores/history outside shared data; avoid hidden automatic Git mutations.
Start/stop explicit bind/port service, default loopback, require access token, export sanitized read-only workspace without history/auth profiles and warn before LAN exposure.
Authenticate and download to explicit destination with bounded payload and schema validation; do not execute foreign content or overwrite existing workspace silently.

capability: Local plugin discovery and service registration
acceptance: Design native extension/plugin contract, list stable IDs/names/versions, initialize with workspace context and register supported services; explicit trust/enable boundary; never load old Java plugins as Swift code.
New headless executable uses the same workspace/preparation/runner/protocol modules; help/version, quiet mode, environment/TLS selection and stable config/runtime/assertion/cancellation exit codes.
List/search, run request/collection including folder alias, import collections, backup/restore/diagnostics and contract checks; test via subprocess against fresh temporary workspaces.
OpenAPI list/import/refresh, GraphQL, performance, mock serve, gRPC, SSE, WebSocket and history diff preserve documented desktop semantics and cancellation.
Git status/init/commit, plugin listing, OAuth client-credentials and share serve/pull work headlessly without printing credentials.
Iterations, delay, retries, continue-on-failure, JSON/Markdown/JUnit report and Allure output use shared run outcomes; empty/cancelled/failed run returns nonzero.

capability: New visual identity and light/dark/system modes
acceptance: Independently designed Rill icon/branding and native menu typography; equivalent interactions and sufficient contrast in every appearance, including payload punctuation and metadata.
VoiceOver labels and reading order, full keyboard navigation, correct focus restore, scalable code text and system reduced-motion support with manual checks.

capability: In-app offline help and API documentation
acceptance: Document each visible feature, shortcut, supported subset, storage/secret policy and CLI command; include searchable offline guide and public Swift API documentation.
Build .app and DMG with new icon/version metadata, all native runtime/compiler resources and CLI, clean prior outputs and verify offline launch on a fresh Mac.

capability: Developer ID signing, notarization and stapling
acceptance: Sign app and nested executables, submit/staple installer, validate Gatekeeper and Keychain identity across upgrades; secrets stay in CI environment and are never committed.
Document minimum/current supported macOS, Intel/Apple Silicon strategy and protocol dependency support; test actual installed artifacts on each claimed target.
Synchronize version/help/bundle/artifacts, generate checksums/release notes and dependency notices, audit source-package exclusions and publish only after PR/CI/release gates pass.
Every baseline row has behavior evidence or an explicitly approved deviation; exercise golden workflows and real TLS/broker endpoints; no menu-only or test-count-only parity claims.
